title: Schritt für Schritt / Stacking

location.series: DB new design / original GIF demonstrations

slide_intent: Build repeated units in sequence because a methodical order makes a group easier to understand.
strategic_value: A rhythmic stack can express DB movement through a consistent modular action.
demonstration: Red horizontal rectangles build into a stack on a dark field, hold and disappear in sequence.
practical_value: Compare the sequence with the source’s stacking principle when establishing order among related elements.
